messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a concise “long‑weekend” calendar for Canada in 2023.  
The table lists the **federal statutory holidays** that create a 3‑day weekend (Friday‑Saturday‑Sunday or Saturday‑Sunday‑Monday).  
Because Canada is a federation, some holidays are **province‑specific** (e.g., Family Day, St. Patrick’s Day, St. George’s Day, etc.).  If you’re targeting a particular province, add the relevant holidays from the “Provincial notes” column.

| # | Holiday (Federal / Provincial) | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---|--------------------------------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|-------|
| 1 | **Family Day** (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, New Brunswick, Manitoba, etc.) | **Feb 20** | Monday | **Feb 18–20** | Creates a 3‑day weekend for the provinces that observe it. |
| 2 | **Good Friday** (all provinces) | **Apr 7** | Friday | **Apr 7–9** | Friday + weekend. |
| 3 | **Victoria Day** (all provinces) | **May 22** | Monday | **May 20–22** | Monday + weekend. |
| 4 | **Labour Day** (all provinces) | **Sep 4** | Monday | **Sep 2–4** | Monday + weekend. |
| 5 | **Thanksgiving** (all provinces) | **Oct 9** | Monday | **Oct 7–9** | Monday + weekend. |
| 6 | **Christmas Day** (all provinces) | **Dec 25** | Monday | **Dec 23–25** | Monday + weekend. |

### Federal holidays that **do NOT** create a long weekend in 2023
| Holiday | Date | Day | Reason |
|---------|------|-----|--------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sunday | Already weekend |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Saturday | Already weekend |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Saturday | Already weekend |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 | Tuesday | Not adjacent to weekend |

### Provincial holidays that can add extra long weekends (examples)

| Province | Holiday | Date | Long‑Weekend Span |
|----------|---------|------|-------------------|
| Ontario | St. Patrick’s Day | Mar 17 (Friday) | Mar 17–19 |
| British Columbia | St. George’s Day | Apr 23 (Friday) | Apr 23–25 |
| Nova Scotia | St. Andrew’s Day | Feb 6 (Friday) | Feb 6–8 |
| Quebec | Saint‑Jean‑Baptiste Day | Jun 24 (Friday) | Jun 24–26 |
| Alberta | Heritage Day | Oct 14 (Friday) | Oct 14–16 |
| Manitoba | Louis Riel Day | Oct 14 (Friday) | Oct 14–16 |
| Saskatchewan | Saskatchewan Day | Oct 14 (Friday) | Oct 14–16 |
| New Brunswick | New Brunswick Day | Oct 14 (Friday) | Oct 14–16 |
| Prince Edward Island | PEI Day | Oct 14 (Friday) | Oct 14–16 |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> • Store the holiday dates in a database keyed by province.  
> • When generating a “long weekend” list, filter by the user’s province and merge the federal and provincial holidays.  
> • For holidays that fall on a weekend, many provinces do **not** observe a substitute day, so they won’t create a long weekend.

Feel free to let me know if you need the full list for a specific province or any additional details!
